title: Saturated Signed Ripple Dynamics on Directed Networks: Machine-Checked Theory and a Preregistered Empirical Test (code, Lean proofs, data analysis)
description: Lean 4/Mathlib formalisation (50 theorems, 63 lemmas, no sorry), synthetic numerical checks, preregistered analysis plans with SHA-256 hashes, analysis scripts and outputs for a Bitcoin OTC test, and the LaTeX source of the accompanying preprint (CC BY 4.0).
